adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` within `createAllCalendarEvents`, the `else` branch for a `destination` without `credentialId` does `createEvent(c, event)` (no third arg). After this diff, `CalendarManager.createEvent` returns `externalId` only from the optional `externalId` parameter and `EventManager` now stores `externalCalendarId` from `result.externalId` (not from `evt.destinationCalendar?.externalId`). Therefore, events created via this branch will produce results with `externalId` undefined, so booking references can no longer store the intended `externalCalendarId` for those created events.
